# FY2019 Cash Conversion Cycle Analysis for General Mills

I will calculate each component of the CCC formula using the provided data.

## Days Inventory Outstanding (DIO)

Average inventory = (1642.2M + 1559.3M) / 2 = 1600.75M

DIO = 365 × (1600.75M / 11108.4M) = 365 × 0.14412 = 52.60 days

## Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)

Average accounts receivable = (1684.2M + 1679.7M) / 2 = 1681.95M

DSO = 365 × (1681.95M / 16865.2M) = 365 × 0.09977 = 36.41 days

## Days Payable Outstanding (DPO)

Change in inventory = 1559.3M - 1642.2M = -82.9M

Average accounts payable = (2746.2M + 2854.1M) / 2 = 2800.15M

DPO = 365 × (2800.15M / (11108.4M + (-82.9M)))
DPO = 365 × (2800.15M / 11025.5M) = 365 × 0.25404 = 92.72 days

## Cash Conversion Cycle

CCC = DIO + DSO - DPO
CCC = 52.60 + 36.41 - 92.72 = **-3.71 days**

General Mills has a negative cash conversion cycle of **-3.71 days**, indicating that the company collects cash from customers and pays inventory costs before it must pay its suppliers, which is favorable for working capital management.
